description.value:
Reportedly inspired by field modifications done to SOR-22s by Militech PMCs, the SAR-55 is rare to encounter, and for good reason. It’s an extremely high RPM machine gun with a singular goal: Put as many rounds down range as possible in the shortest conceivable timespan. It can allow a single cybergrunt to pin down whole squads for a time, but offers no comfort or sophistication.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 55 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only fire in Autofire and Suppressive Fire. If this weapon used Autofire in the previous Round, it can now use Autofire (Machine Gun 5), but Autofire expends 15 rounds instead of 10. If this weapon used Autofire in the previous two Rounds, it can use Autofire at ROF 2. Either half of the ROF 2 can be an Autofire Attack or Suppressive Fire. If there are not enough rounds left in the magazine for Autofire, using Autofire expends the entire magazine. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions. Requires BODY 11+ or being Prone to wield unless Mounted.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
